messages:
sam: hey folks — quick review request for PR #4823: prefetch + kv-cache eviction tweak. small change in eviction comparator (favor more recent prefixes) to reduce cold-token misses. link: https://git.redwood/infra/pr/4823

sam: TL;DR: fixes 95th p50 token latency regressions across short-seq workloads by ~6%. no model changes. touches: runtime/cache/evict.cpp, runtime/prefetcher.{h,cpp}. adds one unit test for eviction order.

sam: diff snippet:
```
- if (age > threshold) evict();
+ if (score(prefix) < score(candidate)) evict_candidate();
```

sam: requesting 2 approvals and a sanity signoff from infra (prefetch behavior). aiming to merge today afternoon if green. @anya @max @kevin PTAL when you have a minute. :pray:

anya: can you drop the perf numbers here? curious about p99 as well. also is this safe for ongoing KV prewarm experiments?

sam: good call. numbers from local canary (N=10 runs): p50 -6%, p95 -4%, p99 -1% (within noise). memory steady. prewarm hit-rate improved ~3%. test harness: `tools/bench/prefetch_small.sh`

max: quick skim looks fine. one edgecase: if two prefixes tie score, how deterministic is order? could cause flapping across instances.

sam: tie-breaker is stable by insertion time; I'll add a unit test to assert determinism across runs.

kevin: please add a short regression test for concurrent eviction vs prewarm (race surface). saw flakiness last month with similar logic. if CI catches it, I'm fine with merging.

sam: adding a concurrent test now, will force a couple of cache race scenarios. also added a comment about fallback behavior to older comparator in case of rollout revert.

deploy-bot: deploy-check: all CI jobs for PR #4823 passed (unit, integration, bench:basic). artifacts uploaded.

anya: left one minor comment inline about a magic constant; otherwise LGTM.

jules: quick ask — can you add a one-line release-note in the changelog? operations might want to know eviction behavior changed.

sam: yep will add changelog entry and the deterministic unit test. planning to wait for kevin's approval on the concurrency test.

kevin: ran the concurrency test locally, looks stable. approved. :thumbsup:

max: approved after the determinism test was added.

sam: thanks all — merging after I push the changelog commit. will canary for 1 hour on prewarm hosts then full rollout. ping me if anything odd shows up. :rocket:

anya: nice! thanks for the quick turnaround.

sam: fyi: if anyone wants to follow the canary metrics, dashboard link: https://dash.redwood/prefetch/canary-4823 (will post update after 30m).
